prompt: As of August 3rd 2024, which movie using the Technicolor dye-transfer process was the last to win the Academy Award for Best Picture?
answer: **The Godfather Part II (1974)** was the last film made using Technicolor’s dye-transfer (IB) printing process to win the Academy Award for Best Picture. It won at the 47th Academy Awards in 1975 and was among the final American films printed using the process before Technicolor’s Hollywood lab closed that year.
